title: SSA National 800 Number Network operational data

800-number-average-speed-to-answer.csv.definition: Average Speed to Answer: total time calls spend in queue divided by calls answered.

800-number-call-volume-and-agent-busy-ra.definition: Monthly calls offered to customer service representatives, busy calls, and representative busy rate.

pedagogical_use: Private, restricted classroom use. The activity forecasts observed queue congestion; it does not optimize staffing.
